payload.title: stale comments describe removed guard caps
payload.body: Beside stance-guard-precise: test-stance-guardrail.sh (lines 136-139 and its HERMETIC STATE comment) still calls the per-session state a block budget a no-progress detector suppresses, and forge's omp render.ts (around line 731, emitted into the module) still says the rubric is cut to 14 KB. Both mechanisms are gone. Small cleanup for a following plan.
